title: Travel-Issue Service Fee Refunds and Rewards Credits (Finance Q&A)
content:
# Finance Q&A — travel-issue service-fee refund where Roamhaven Rewards credits paid part of the stay

**The rule.** When Roamhaven Rewards credits paid part of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the credit-funded part of the travel-issue service-fee refund goes back as credits and only the rest is paid to the card: when credits were redeemed on the stay and none of them has been reinstated yet, the card receives the travel-issue service-fee refund times one minus the credits redeemed divided by the stay's total price; when credits were redeemed on the stay and part of them has already been reinstated, the card receives it times one minus the credits still outstanding (redeemed less reinstated) divided by the stay's total price; otherwise, including when no credits were redeemed, the card receives the whole travel-issue service-fee refund. The credit-funded part is taken out after the percentage has been applied to the fee base, and the result is rounded half up to the cent once.

**Where are the credits read?**
From the stay's entries in the guest's Roamhaven Rewards ledger — credits redeemed and credits reinstated. The total price is the one recorded on the stay.

**Worked: total price 2,500.00, 250.00 redeemed, none reinstated, refund 106.50 before the split.**
Card share one minus 0.10, that is 0.90; card part 95.85.

**Worked: the same with all 250.00 reinstated.**
With everything reinstated, neither of the first two cases applies, so the card receives the whole 106.50.

**Worked: no credits redeemed.**
The card receives 106.50.
